reflection: Volume-based relative/market factors (AAPL/NVDA volume ratio, QQQ volume surge) are the only ones that have joined; most other factors help in 2023 and 2025 but hurt in 2022 and 2024, suggesting regime dependence. Close-location and range factors help mainly in 2025 and RF. Longer windows (z60, 5/60 trends) were near-copies or worse, so I will stay with short windows and try different normalisations. I will try volume ratios against other peers (MSFT), rank-like transforms of volume, and cross-asset range/close-location signals that avoid sign-flip issues in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: qqq_volume_surge_5d_smooth
lessons.lesson: Smoothing the QQQ volume surge over 5/60 days kept the 2023 and 2025 gains but still hurt in 2022 and 2024, so it adds little beyond the 20d version.

lessons.name: log_aapl_nvda_volume_ratio_z60
lessons.lesson: A 60-day z-score is nearly the same as the 20-day one (0.91 similarity) and lost 2024 badly, so the longer window brings nothing.

lessons.name: aapl_range_zscore_20
lessons.lesson: Standardized Apple range is close to daily range and helped only on top of the team in LR, a weak regime-dependent signal.

lessons.name: qqq_msft_volume_ratio_z20
lessons.lesson: QQQ/MSFT volume ratio carries mostly the same stress information as QQQ volume surge and added nothing on the team.

lessons.name: aapl_volume_trend_5_60
lessons.lesson: Apple's own volume trend is a slow variable that duplicates volume_to_ma20 and hurt in 2022, giving no directional edge.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_qqq_5d_vs_volume_z
lessons.lesson: Multiplying a relative return by a volume z-score created a noisy interaction that failed in nearly every year.

factors.name: log_aapl_msft_volume_ratio_z20
factors.hypothesis: The AAPL/NVDA log volume ratio z-score worked, but 2024 failed possibly due to NVDA-specific volume; MSFT is a steadier mega-cap comparator and may give the same relative-attention signal more stably.

factors.name: log_aapl_nvda_volume_ratio_z10
factors.hypothesis: A shorter 10-day standardization adapts faster to regime shifts (2024 failure) while remaining distinct from the 20d and 60d versions.

factors.name: nvda_close_loc_minus_aapl_close_loc
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_Close, NVDA_Low), subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low)), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_Close, AAPL_Low), subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low)))
factors.hypothesis: If NVDA closed near its high while Apple closed weak, Apple may catch up or lag next day; the intraday buying pressure gap between leader and Apple is a new cross-asset signal.

factors.name: qqq_range_z20_minus_aapl_range_z20
factors.hypothesis: Whether Apple's intraday turbulence is unusual relative to the market's own turbulence flags idiosyncratic stress that tends to mean-revert.

factors.name: aapl_range_vs_qqq_range_ratio
factors.hypothesis: QQQ volume surge flags market stress; Apple's range relative to QQQ's says whether Apple is amplifying or damping that stress, complementing the volume signal.

factors.name: aapl_gap_fill_residual_3d
factors.hypothesis: Average intraday (open-to-close) return over 3 days describes Apple's own recent session drift, which together with the sector-vs-Apple range gap may separate trending from choppy turbulence.
